scenarios.title: Multi-Timeframe Context: EUR/USD
scenarios.questionText: Compare the Daily (HTF) chart against the 1-Hour (LTF) chart on EUR/USD. What is the macro vs local contextual relationship?
options: HTF and LTF are aligned in Bullish Uptrend expansion
Both timeframes are trapped in random horizontal noise without structure
LTF has completely reversed the HTF multi-month macro trend
HTF is consolidating while LTF is experiencing extreme volatility blowout
scenarios.correctAnswer: HTF and LTF are aligned in Bullish Uptrend expansion
scenarios.explanation: The Daily chart establishes dominant macro order flow (Bullish), while the 1-Hour chart provides execution granularity (impulse alignment).
